remarks: Look no further for the perfect combination of comfort and style, in one of Wilton's best located South Wilton neighborhoods! Edith Lane is a quiet tree-lined culdesac of 8 houses, including new and high-value homes, and is convenient to Wilton Center, schools, hiking trails, shopping and easy commutes. The house is spacious in all the right places, including an eat-in kitchen open to the family room with fireplace and adjoining flexible space for casual or formal settings. The home office/playroom plus the mudroom/laundry area with entries from driveway and garage, completes the thoughtful design of the main level. And with a fully finished walkout lower level, there is enough privacy and space for all ages and interests. Upper floor Primary Suite has a large bonus sitting or dressing area, plus dreamy walk-in closet, spa-like bath, custom built-ins and tray ceiling. Enjoy outdoor living on the deck and patios overlooking a large level back yard for games and fun. With updates throughout, there is nothing to do but unpack and start enjoying your lovely new home!
